games.title: Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3
games.description: Станьте частиною історії від початку до грандіозного фіналу серії ігор Attack on Titan. Гра з використанням пристрою просторового маневрування (ODM) стала ще просунутішою й забезпечує найзахопливіші та найстильніші бої в історії серії.

games.title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.description: Нова пригода в серії фентезійних ігор із головоломками «Професор Лейтон», продажі якої перевищили 20 млн копій у всьому світі. Професор Лейтон і Люк беруться за загадкову справу в Стім-Байсоні — місті винаходів, що працює завдяки паровим технологіям.

games.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
games.description: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.title: A-Train 9 PRIME LINE
games.description: The ultimate edition of the city-building simulation game A-Train 9! As the president of a railway company, build the city of your dreams through city building and railway management. A-Train 9 PRIME LINE takes city building beyond evolution, delivering the ultimate city-building experience.

games.title: Rayman Legends Retold
games.description: Відкрийте сміливе переосмислення улюбленого платформера з оновленою графікою та свіжим поглядом на знайомий сюжет. Грайте в соло-режимі або збирайте компанію до 4 осіб для гри в кооперативному режимі на одній консолі. Досліджуйте таємничий новий світ, проходьте нові музичні рівні та багато іншого!

games.title: STAGE TOUR
games.description: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

games.title: FreeStyle Football 2
games.description: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

games.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.description: Тіні — ваші союзники. Поверніться до міста як майстер-злодій Garrett у цій оновленій класичній грі від Nightdive Studios. Крадіжки, підступні витівки та хитрощі у світі, де довіра — це розкіш, а кожна вкрадена таємниця має свою ціну.

games.title: Tales from the Watchtower - The Conjurer
games.description: An episodic psychological horror game set in La Mancha, the rural heart of inland Spain and land of Don Quixote. Inspired by real events near the mysterious Watchtower of Ciudad Real, each episode explores current legends and local folklore where reality and myth blur.

games.title: Peg Together
games.description: Peg Together is a multiplayer puzzle game that puts you against a friend to see who can achieve the highest score by hitting the most pegs with the furthest shots! Explore through different levels and worlds and master them all to win against your friend!

games.title: Spheromania
games.description: Bounce, blast, and outlast in Spheromania. A fast-paced arena shooter where drones duel with blasters, mines, and mid-air hops. Manage your energy, dodge the shrinking arena, and be the last sphere hovering. Solo mode or online multiplayer.

games.title: RabbitHole Island : Turn-based Vtuber Battles
games.description: A FREE game where you explore an island and battle vtubers in epic turn-based combat. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Story Those who follow the mouse eventually find themselves on Rabbithole Island, an island dominated by supernatural creatures. But the real danger is the pull of curiosity. Take a peek into a parallel world, a fascinating ecosystem, through the eyes of an overly curious observer. Follow along a journey of self-development, misadv

games.title: Starforce Rangers
games.description: A small online Space RPG. Made to enter space! Fly around with others and level up. Battle against other ships or do other missions.

games.title: TechRunners
games.description: TechRunners is an open-world 2.5D MMORPG set in the city of New Haven, where survival means climbing to the top. Start from nothing, build your empire, and take on rival TechRunners and Megacorporations. Form a crew to take control of the city or use your talents to climb the arena rankings.

games.title: Tyrofeud
games.description: The perfect 1v1 mini games galore for casual scrubs like us. You and your sibling are tasked to complete certain chores before your mom returns home. Let them know you are THE superior sibling. Be the one to complete more assignments so you can get all the love from mommy. You can choose to do either of these things at a given time: COMPLETE CHORES To win the game, you will need to complete more tasks than your sibling. These are simple tasks such as cleaning the toilet, putting fruits on the fridge, and many more.

games.title: Ventory
games.description: A strange little command line puzzle game for Linux and Windows. Use the items in your inventory and outventory to solve each level and get to the exit.

games.title: Gravitus
games.description: Enter a massive battlefield where two teams clash over resources, strategy, and firepower. Start as infantry, pilot hover tanks or flying pods, and unleash laser-based combat in a sci-fi warzone reminiscent of classic space battles.

games.title: 秋之轻语
games.description: VN.Your neighbor died in a fall — yet the very next day, she appeared inside your mind, as if an unseen hand were pulling every string. Everything feels dreamlike, unreal. You seem to have boarded a train that accelerates beyond control; in the chaos, you clutch at something — perhaps the truth.

games.title: DigSite: Archeology in Egypt
games.description: DigSite is open-world archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archeologist.

games.title: Clayground
games.description: Welcome to Clayground—the next-gen multiplayer VR experience where imagination knows no bounds! Whether you're a VR veteran or stepping into virtual reality for the first time, Clayground invites you to a playground like no other.

games.title: test
games.description: A classic side scrolling game level that combines platform jumping, action combat, and puzzle exploration. Players control their characters to move horizontally on a two-dimensional plane, gradually solving puzzles and defeating enemies through jumping, attacking, and obstacle avoidance operations.

games.title: Jacob's Ladder
games.description: Jacob’s Ladder is a haunting first-person puzzler where YOU are the solution. Swap bodies and stack puzzle pieces to please The Maker. Question the nature of the soul and earn your humanity - before it’s too late.

games.title: GrappleBurger
games.description: GrappleBurger is a high-management cooking game where multitasking is the only way to get your orders out. Master the chaos of the kitchen as you fry, blend, grill, and craft your way up the leaderboards! Do you have what it takes to be a top chef?

games.title: Var Game Simulator
games.description: Var Game Simulator allows you to manage critical moments of football like a VAR referee. Carefully examine offside, penalty and card decisions and make the right decision. Experience the excitement of football through the eyes of a referee with realistic scenarios!

games.title: Raiders Rise
games.description: Explore hostile planets, face endless hordes of devourers, collect crystals, and upgrade your equipment. Choose the hero that best suits your playstyle, cooperate with your allies to survive… or betray the other team at the perfect moment and claim victory.

games.title: HexBrandPre
games.description: Story of VoltSpark. Choose the most suitable set of equipments for you, then dodge the bullets and crash the enemies. A bullet-hell game, which is quite difficult. Instant reactions, level understanding, strategies are requird to beat this game. As agile as leopard, ruin everything like thunder.

games.title: Infinite Soul
games.description: Infinite Soul is a breath of fresh air for competitive fighters. Every battle will test your skill, cunning, and resolve. Attack and defend with Water, Earth, Fire, and Air; choose wisely because each one has a strength and a weakness.

games.title: Ether Void
games.description: New York, the 90s. Detective Frank Miller investigates a murder in a grim metropolis. Your window to the truth is an old terminal. Analyze data, crack codes, uncover digital trails. Remember: not everyone here wants you to succeed.

games.title: On Sight
games.description: On Sight is a love letter to classic shooters that drops players into high energy gunfights in arenas across the galaxy. Play with friends, strangers, or solo with bot support on every map.

games.title: Clash of Worlds
games.description: Clash of Worlds is a turn-based strategic card game. Similar gameplay mechanics to Yu-Gi-Oh!. Featuring multiple supported formats and a developer who cares about fun. All gameplay is manual, as if playing 'in real life'. Join the Stoat server for help or questions. Stoat: https://stt.gg/K8jk6Dxd

games.title: Ninja Kaizen
games.description: Free-to-play, turn-based ninja RPG. Master the elements, build your jutsu, bring a pet and join a clan to fight bosses and rivals worldwide. Rise from Genin to Sage and carve your name into the global rankings. Free Ninja Kaizen account required.

games.title: Cult: Manos
games.description: Rediscover true meaning of Manos. Delve into a psychological mystery where movie making mistakes the key to uncovering the true horror. The survivors are waiting for you to discover it. Jackey Raye Neyman Jones (The Original Debbie) is 'looks forward to seeing' this dark restoration.

games.title: Vibes TCG
games.description: Welcome to Vibes, a Trading Card Game full of Pudgy Penguins! Vibes brings together strategy and fun, perfect for newcomers to TCGs as well as experienced players. Create a custom “huddle” of quirky Characters, pick bold Actions and collect powerful Relics. The goal? Outsmart your opponent, win the favor of Baron Fishpockets and claim victory. Are you ready to join the Penguins and make your way to the top? Dive into Vibes and let the adventure begin!

games.title: The Calling
games.description: An anime-inspired free-to-play PvP arena shooter where every match is shaped by your build, strategy, and creativity. Customize your abilities, adapt to dynamic weather and day-night cycles, and outplay the competition in fast-paced battles.

games.title: Isometric House Builder
games.description: A cozy 2D isometric building game with pixel art style. Follow blueprints to place blocks and construct houses step by step. Balance accuracy and creativity as you complete foundations, walls, and roofs, turning simple plans into charming pixel-art homes.

games.title: LOOPR
games.description: A fast-paced puzzle platformer where you must loop through variations of the same level in order to win! Collect artifacts to make the previously impossible actually possible.

games.title: Eryndor
games.description: Eryndor es un RPG de supervivencia y acción en estilo low-poly donde exploras vastos mundos, recolectas recursos, combates enemigos y compites en intensos modos PvP.

games.title: Blood Arena Path of Steel: Prologue
games.description: Fight your way through brutal medieval arenas in this free prologue featuring physics-driven melee combat, effective armor systems, and violent consequences.

games.title: Anomalift
games.description: Everything is normal. Or is it? Anomalift is a cooperative anomaly-spotting game where observation is your greatest tool. Search each area, and report your findings. One mistake leads you somewhere you were never meant to be.

games.title: Ex Decreto
games.description: Ex Decreto puts you in the role of governor of a province recently conquered by Rome: Dalmatia, in the 1st century AD. Administer justice wisely to maintain peace and assert Roman rule! Be careful, however, not to make too many errors in judgment.

games.title: Tavernia
games.description: A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

games.title: 100 Anomaly Cats
games.description: 🐾 Приєднуйся до наймилішої пригоди в тематичних локаціях, повних котиків! 😻 Досліджуй чарівні намальовані від руки місця та спробуй знайти 100 прихованих котиків у грі. 🐈🕵️‍♂️ Чи зможеш ти знайти їх усіх? 🕵️‍♂️🐈

games.title: potato_milki's The TRIALISTS
games.description: The TRIALISTS is a Time Attack 4-Player Co-op FPS that has an emphasis on fast-paced movement, precise gunplay, and absolutely ZERO hand-holding. Featuring an Art Style that resembles B-Games of the 2010s.

games.title: Beatcore zero
games.description: Try Beatcore for free! A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. This version does not permit access to the workshop.

games.title: Atlas Proxima: Tether
games.description: Stay in touch with earth as you travel the solar system, in this co-operative online multiplayer idler world filled with curated content to discover and play together.

games.title: Isekai Guardians
games.description: Isekai Guardians: Celestria — браузерна MMORPG (яку іноді відносять до жанру PBBG) у постійному фентезійному світі, де в центрі уваги — довготривалий розвиток персонажа, спілкування з іншими гравцями та онлайн-контент, що постійно поповнюється. Ви розвиваєте одного персонажа, поєднуючи класичні системи MMORPG зі спокійним симулятором життя. Покликані з іншого світу королівською родиною Arcluna, ви потрапляєте до Celestria в часи наростаючої смути. Король демонів знову набирає сили, політичні чвари розколюють королі

games.title: REMNANT: Rebirth
games.description: Explore the silent echoes of a fallen open-world in REMNANT: Rebirth. Navigate lush, overgrown ruins where nature has reclaimed its throne and zombies lurk in the shadows. Master survival, uncover secrets of a lost civilization, and endure the challenges of an untamed post-apocalyptic era.

games.title: Just an Ordinary Bike Ride
games.description: In this adventure horror game you experience nothing but a calm bike ride home, your chauffeur is late and it's starting to rain. You only have a bike but you need to get home, it's a rather empty street aside from some debris. It's just a bike ride home.

games.title: Feral Prince
games.description: Rip Soul Orbs from weakened enemies, forge them into black-jade Soul Tiles, and lock five into a poker hand that reshapes your next fight. Dokkaebi Masks cheat the rules, while escaped Husks return as Wraiths carrying the power you stole. A 2D action roguelite.

games.title: God of War Laufey
games.description: Нова глава легендарної серії від Santa Monica Studio. Після смерті Фей опиняється в потойбічному Everywhen і має захистити Кратоса та Атрея. PlayStation підтвердила вихід на PS5 20 травня 2027 року.

games.title: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
games.description: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

games.title: Persona 4 Revival
games.description: Pre-order now and receive exclusive bonuses that will elevate your Persona 4 Revival experience! Early purchasers will unlock the P3R & P5R Extra BGM Set, featuring iconic music tracks from Persona 3 Reload and Persona 5 Royal that will be available for selection within the game. Persona 4 Revival: P3R & P5R Extra BGM Set Persona 3 Reload BGMs include: 1. Dungeon BGM: Basement (P3R ver.) 2. Boss Battle BGM: Heartful Cry 3. Result BGM: After the Battle (P3R ver.) Persona 5 Royal BGMs include: 1. Dungeon BGM: The Whi

games.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
games.description: Із полум’я війни постає фенікс. Рольова гра у жанрі темного фентезі Three Kingdoms від Team NINJA. Опануйте акробатичні прийоми китайських бойових мистецтві підкоріть безкраї поля битв у Three Kingdoms, де вам протистоятимуть могутні генерали й demons.

games.title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
games.description: Atelier Karia розповідає про шукачку пригод, яка втратила спогади й мусить зіткнутися з минулим. Нові функції урізноманітнюють битви й алхімію. Синтезовані згодяться в дослідженнях, а інгредієнти дають різні ефекти.

games.title: Fable
games.description: Станьте героєм власних мрій в цій атмосферній рольовій грі з відкритим світом, де кожне рішення впливає на ваш шлях, репутація важливіша за все інше, а щасливий кінець ніхто не гарантує.

games.title: METRO 2039
games.description: METRO 2039 — новий знаковий шутер від першої особи від 4A Games, визнаних майстрів оповіді. Вирушайте в саме серце темної постапокаліптичної Москви, де на вас чекає жорстоке протистояння, від якого залежить доля Метро.

games.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
games.description: A new semester begins as fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.

games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
games.description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

games.title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
games.description: У ліках, що дарують життя, прихована отрута. ПРО ГРУ Виготовляйте трав'яні ліки й покладайтеся на кмітливість і дедукцію, щоб розкрити правду про «П'ять таємниць» і «П'ять проклять» — дві низки дивних явищ і змов, що сіють хаос у задньому палаці, кварталі розваг і на вулицях столиці. Аптекарці Maomao доведеться застосувати всю свою кмітливість і знання, щоб розгадати таємниці й розкрити правду про фальшивого брата імператора. ЗБИРАЙТЕ ЗАЧІПКИ Й РОЗГАДУЙТЕ ТАЄМНИЦІ Опитуйте свідків, проводьте розслідування на місцях

games.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
games.description: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

games.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.description: Отримайте задоволення від приголомшливого рімейку першої пригоди Лари Крофт і відкрийте загублені таємниці Атлантиди завдяки неймовірній графіці, сучасному ігровому процесу та сюрпризам, які зберігають дух оригіналу.

games.title: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
games.description: Станьте пілотом, яким вам судилося бути. Змініть долю людства в GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, динамічному екшені, що по-новому розкриває Gundam через кінематографічну історію та нищівні бої.

games.title: Tropico 7
games.description: Все або нічого! У Tropico 7 ви знову взуваєте блискучі черевики Ель-Президента, щоб розбудувати свою острівну державу і - в буквальному сенсі - звернути гори. Як славний лідер, ви ведете своїх вірних громадян (і свій рахунок у швейцарському банку) до невимовного процвітання.

games.title: Elta: Defy All Gods
games.description: Пробивайтеся крізь спотворені світи разом зі своїм супутником, драконом-богом, у насиченому адреналіном пригодницькому платформері, що поєднує вільний ближній бій, пливкий платформінг і науково-фантастичні дослідження. Станьте обранцем занепалого бога, Ельти.

games.title: Arizona Sunshine®
games.description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

games.title: Their Sky
games.description: Their Sky is an idle deck-builder. Select cards and strategies as you build decks that can win on their own. Rather than managing moves, Their Sky all in on deck building: turn your favorite cards into self-running engines.

games.title: PNG RPG
games.description: A pixel-art RPG in a 3D open world where you can build towns, manage people, explore a infinitely generated world, and battle monsters and foes alike.

games.title: Lurking In Fear
games.description: Enjoy the love of zombie games without the feeling of being locked down to a story mode! Enjoy a open world zombie era, loot, and explore! OR if you want a change in pace, Play a new round based zombies mode that will keep you loving or Re Loving Round based zolmbies!

games.title: Bloodshot Eyes
games.description: Core Gameplay Fast-paced, Splatter shooter. The game features many ways to approach an enemy: Play defensive, bait out the attacks and strike ensuring the enemy can never guard. Play aggressive, get close and personal smashing through any attempt to guard. Play resourcefully, wait for the right attack and parry it for sweet double damage. Play what feels right, adapt to each enemies gimmick. The shop upgrades keep every new game cycle feeling fresh, meta perks, whacky perks all kinds of perks. Interconnected world

games.title: New Rule
games.description: Président, the card game everyone knows, with a twist: after every game, the table votes a new rule. Bluff on your tax cards, snitch on a rival, gamble your jokers on a slot machine… The rules pile up game after game, and no two tables ever play the same game.

games.title: Rust Onslaught
games.description: Rust Onslaught is a top-down shooter where you play as the robot R-75, as he takes out everything he sees. Humanity Is Dead, Robots Own The Earth, and you have become a danger.

games.title: Star Squadrons: Galactic Trading Card Game
games.description: No mana. Hidden threats. Your move—even on your opponent’s turn! Command your squadron and fight for control of five locations in a tactical sci-fi trading card game. Our planned 2027 Kickstarter will let you bring your own physical tournament decks to local events.

games.title: Shadow of Backrooms
games.description: Shadow of Backrooms is a co-op horror game set in endless liminal rooms. Explore the Backrooms with up to 4 friends, solve puzzles and escape the entities before they catch you. But be warned: you are not alone.

games.title: Vizarri
games.description: A monster-taming RPG set on the planet of Valaar. Capture and train mystical creatures known by the locals as Vizarri. Battle other trainers in tactical, turn-based combat on a dynamic grid. Explore islands, collect items, and outsmart a rising enemy force. These are the Adventures of Valaar.

games.title: tower sequence KNIGHT LOBSTER
games.description: YOU WILL LOSE EVERYTHING. YOU WILL GAIN EVERYTHING. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP. THIS WORLD WILL REACH PEACE, AT ANY COST. YOU MUST REACH THE TOP.

games.title: Dug Out
games.description: 'Dug Out' is an exciting multiplayer PvP game for 2-4 players, where you dive into an underground arena and engage in intense battles. Armed with guns, you'll dig through the environment to uncover hidden opponents and outsmart your rivals.

games.title: Metronome
games.description: Metronome is a short semi auto-biographical interactive story about the life of a British musician spanning from the early 90s to the late 2020s.

games.title: 蝎之尾 (TailofScorpios)
games.description: 'Scorpion's Tail' is a AVG set in an alternate historical timeline. In the war-born nation of SouthXi, a conspiracy involving girls begins to surface.Investigator Zhang Cheng meets a mysterious girl. After accepting request, he is drawn into a web of secrets.

games.title: CrossSwords: FPS Crosswords
games.description: Solve the crossword and start shooting! Race your opponents to solve clues, earn ammo and power-ups, and then fight in an arena built from the crossword grid itself. Battle friends and players online!

games.title: Arena
games.description: Directional, team-focused medieval PvP. Fight 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3 with sword, bow and staff, choose your abilities from a wide selection, and outplay your opponents with timing, reads and teamwork. Climb the ranked ladder. Now in open alpha.

games.title: Infested
games.description: Infested is a simple First Person Shooter. You will encounter many zombies as you fight your way through the zombie-infested city. Will you make it to the hospital to find the first infected victim? Only with its DNA samples will science be able to create an antidote.

games.title: Runic Prophecy
games.description: Runic Prophecy is a challenging third-person soulslike action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Explore Eyjusheim, unleash magic and a dragon in combat, battle supernatural creatures, and uncover the hidden lore of a shattered world.

games.title: OS95 Plus!
games.description: OS95 Plus! is the newest first person puzzle adventure game from Gev Creates. You're stuck in a mysterious facility and are forced to indefinitely partake in software testing. You must navigate rooms and solve puzzles to escape and uncover the truth behind the experiment.

games.title: The Frutiger Utopia
games.description: Blast back into the 2000s with a brand new puzzle-adventure game with a side of platforming! Guide protagonists Victoria, Xenu, Lily, and Jerone through all 30 levels (6 worlds), as they become more familiar with the new world they have found themselves into! With soundtracks from artist Carboluka (You can find them on bluesky and newgrounds), creating soundtracks for all 6 worlds in the game! I appreciate it! For Demo 1, this contains World 1, with a (pretty close to finish) demo of Level 1! All the other levels a

games.title: Ascend and Fall
games.description: Ascend and Fall — мультиплеєрний автобатлер у стилі темного фентезі, де результат бою вирішує порядок ваших заклять. Зберіть власний набір заклять, полюйте на монстрів заради здобичі та випускайте потужні магічні комбо проти суперників. Побудуйте вірну послідовність і підніміться, поки інші падають.

games.title: PC Versus
games.description: The first ever competitive PC building game. Go head to head with another player on the same task and budget, pick from 800+ real components and overclock for an edge. Push too hard and your build crashes. Free to play.

games.title: JungoJam
games.description: JungoJam now boasts a hip downtown strip, tranquil beaches, and islands perfect for unleashing your creativity. Here, you can be anyone you dream of! Team up with friends from across the globe to explore an interactive wonderland, design your Original Characters！

games.title: Flushed Forward
games.description: Control a limbless sewer creature on board a large speed boat pursued by a massive sewer tidal wave in this Arcade experience! Defend against enemies by vaulting across your boat to stomp on their heads!

games.title: BLACKFRAG
games.description: Dive into a fast-paced and competitive arena FPS where every match tests your reflexes and strategy. Fast and precise combat: fluid movement and high-intensity gameplay. Varied weapons: adapt your playstyle with a balanced arsenal. Dynamic arenas: each map offers new challenges and opportunities. Competitive multiplayer mode: face your friends or other players and climb to the top of the leaderboard. Get ready to enter the arena, sharpen your skills, and crush your opponents. BLACKFRAG is the ultimate playground fo

'Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?' A midnight 'Unsend' trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead 'You.' Become a 'Ghost' inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.

games.title: Economic Biathlon
games.description: Test your wits in an arcade quiz. React quickly and overcome tricky challenges. You can set new records and compete in Economic Biathlon.

games.title: Mascot Mayhem (Asymmetrical Horror)
games.description: Asymmetrical Mascot Horror survival game where two mascots must team up to kill ALL the survivors. Featuring crossover characters from all across the mascot horror universe (and beyond!)

games.title: Darn Guy Adventures
games.description: Darn Guy Adventures is an RPG adventure following the titular Kishan 'Darn Guy', Tinta and Norton as they are sent into a mission they are utterly underqualified for. Encounter verbose bushes, mathematical rocks and very loud wolfmen on the quest to save a town with an expiration date.

games.title: 能動的ダンジョン
games.description: This game is a simple, high-difficulty RPG for people who are tired of the same old turn-based command-based RPGs. You can enjoy strategic battles where you respond to enemy attacks and manage a stamina-like energy called 'SP (Spirit),' as well as the freedom to create builds by configuring your equipment. ◎Primary target audience for this game People who play games regularly. People who want to enjoy the game more than the story. People who want to enjoy a high-difficulty command-based turn-based RPG. People who w

games.title: Escape With Friends
games.description: Investigate with your friends in this hilarious hand drawn game. Draw your own skin and go on a journey filled with minigames: darts, mini car races, electrical panels... From 2 to 8 players.

games.title: Addie Shen
games.description: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

games.title: Midwatch Engineer
games.description: You are a ship engineer, keep watch at night, build and repair stuff on a lathe and a milling machine by day. In this Game you will machine parts from raw metal instead of just combining items to craft. You directly control the axis of the lathe.

games.title: Deck Beasts
games.description: Creature-collecting auto-battler roguelike. Draft pixel-art beasts, teach them ability cards, gear them with items and relics, then watch your squad fight other players' teams. 100+ beasts, hundreds of abilities and items, billions of builds.

games.title: TiNk
games.description: MAKE THE PIECES OF YOUR LIFE Connect each part of your life, and make your own path CREATE The parts of your life are represented by worlds, a sandbox 3D space where you can make anything DRAW You can draw extremely easy in 3D in order to make anything WRITE You have books, in them you can take notes. They're independent from the worlds. Markup languages like markdown and fountain are supported, so you can open any folder that contains these types of files and simply read/write them

games.title: The Witcher IV
games.description: Початок нової саги у відкритому світі. Цірі вирушає власним шляхом, щоб стати професійною мисливицею на чудовиськ. CD PROJEKT RED підтвердила цільове вікно виходу — 2028 рік.

games.title: 星と塔と冒険者
games.description: A 2D × 3D fantasy RPG where you investigate a mysterious tower that suddenly appeared. Fight, explore, and uncover the truth of the world.

games.title: くろねこ・ぷれい・ろーる！
games.description: 「くろねこ・ぷれい・ろーる！」は、3D空間で主人公のねこを操作し、会話でストーリーが進行するRPGです。VR・PC（Windows）の両方でプレイ可能です。プレイヤーであるあなたは、不思議な本に閉じ込められてしまった主人公の「ゆかいなくろもふねこちゃん」になり、問題を解決しながら本から脱出しましょう。

games.title: 祓ノ狐
games.description: Purifying Fox is a Japanese-style action adventure inspired by a book found in an old shrine storehouse. The story shifts between two phases: Escape, where you cannot fight and must survive, and Purification, where you seal the spirits and restore balance.

games.title: Zoe's Game
games.description: Escape from a mansion full of puzzles, traps and characters who may not be what they seem! Can you survive to this deadly birthday party?

games.title: Villainville
games.description: Join the outcasts of Villainville in this cozy farming sim adventure where Stardew Valley meets Shrek. Grow magic crops, tame the tiny unicorns, sneak into the night market, and befriend misfit fairy tale characters. Bonus? Find the misery mushroom plague saboteur and redeem the irredeemable.

games.title: Non-Euclidean Design
games.description: Have you ever played a non-Euclidean game and wondered if it would be nice to design with it? Have you ever played a house designing game and not have enough space in your room or house? Non-Euclidean Design is the answer. This game lets you fix up your non-Euclidean house without restraints of Euclidean space. Your house can be bigger on the inside, rooms can take up the same space, and doors can serve as portals to other rooms in the house. Currently, the game will be played in Sandbox, but eventually with the ad

games.title: Jeff and Crackhead
games.description: Explore a quirky top-down RPG/platformer as Jeff and Crackhead! Solve puzzles, dodge traps, and uncover secrets in the overworld. Battles mix turn-based strategy with real-time action—dodge, parry, and unleash powerful combos. Fast-paced, simple, and packed with nonsensical fun!

games.title: SUPER DEBT
games.description: Money is your life in SUPER DEBT! Fight to survive with an arsenal of wildly different weapons and upgrades. In this intense and challenging Twin-Stick Bullet-Hell Roguelike everything costs money, and we mean everything!

games.title: Digital Artmaster: Volume 8
games.description: Explore the artistry behind stunning digital worlds with this exclusive visual artbook. Featuring high-resolution artwork, intricate designs, and breathtaking environments, it offers a glimpse into the creative process, perfect for fans of imaginative storytelling and digital art.

games.title: Dining Deck
games.description: We fused co-op strategy, deckbuilding, and restaurant chaos into the ultimate roguelike dining experience! Build your deck, serve customers, master the kitchen, and secure your place amongst the Hall of Taste!

games.title: I'm a Human
games.description: Забудьте про захист. Це зворотна оборона вежі, де ви — загроза. Керуйте штучним інтелектом, будуйте роботів та знищуйте людські бази. Ваша мета — вторгнення. Ваша зброя — рій.

games.title: Full Duplex
games.description: Two eyes. Two hands. One brain. Pilot two independent vehicles at once in this single-player co-op, coordinating flanks, feints, and split objectives entirely solo. Full Duplex is a true test of focus: can your mind run two fronts at once?

games.title: Chaoslands
games.description: This game is a pixel-styled, turn-based sandbox game. Collect around 50 items and build or find 100 obstacles accross the world. Build ships to cross water and enter the caves to collect advanced resources. Fight 2 bosses and level up.

games.title: Guild of Slayers
games.description: Survivors-like in full 3D with ragdoll physics. Enemies throw themselves at you as projectiles, crash into allies, and damage each other. Bodies fly. Chaos reigns. Survive waves of undead in the most satisfying horde-slaughter you've ever seen. 🔥💀

games.title: Guardian Order
games.description: 1-4 co-op action roguelite where you explore ever-changing dungeons with your allies. Choose from various weapons and talents, and defeat enemies through strategic combat using environmental elements like water, fire, and electricity. Develop the Order’s base to unlock new abilities

games.title: Snowbound: Steam Voyage
games.description: You drive your steam-powered truck across the snowbound wastelands left by the Great Frostfall. Ice has claimed the world, but not your resolve. Scavenge, rebuild, and cultivate what life remains. Somewhere in the endless white, the past still breathes

games.title: Kastle Kraft
games.description: Gather, craft, and then automate resources to build fabulous Kastles. Beware the locals don't like you destroying their land. Defend your Kastles through combat and defenses. Explore the land to find additional recipes, resources, and items to help you defend and build your Kingdom!

games.title: Celestial Conquest
games.description: Blast off in this retro-style space shooter! Conquer planets, outwit AI enemies, and survive the dangers of deep space in fast-paced, nostalgic pixel action.

games.title: Chess Peace
games.description: Find your way back to the surface by learning new movement patterns, out-maneuvring enemies, and helping stray figures in a surreal chess-inspired metroidbrainia.

games.title: Solis
games.description: Join Nina and RAM with a friend to explore the puzzles and challenges of Solis. Discover the mysteries and the natural and technological wonders of Tortuga Island as you embark on a journey toward the abandoned factory. Play in local split-screen co-op or online using the Friend Pass.

games.title: 研究生病院
games.description: A visual novel set in the modern or near-future era. You play as a male protagonist struggling with psychological trauma after graduate school, as he reconnects with three heroines. Through player choices, you will develop relationships, and uncover the past of each character.

games.title: MindCleaver
games.description: Manipulate the minds of fully simulated NPCs as you and a rival sorcerer twist emotion, factions, and armies in a dark, emergent fantasy world.

games.title: Haunted Lakes of Austin
games.description: Explore the real Haunted Lakes of Austin, boat and fish for hidden treasures, and survive the darkness in this eerie adventure where every cast could awaken something beneath the surface. BOAT, FISH, SURVIVE

games.title: The Blade
games.description: 2.5D Action Roguelite that fuses Hong Kong-style Action Cinema environmental interaction with hardcore martial arts combat.physics is as deadly as your blade. Kick&Launch: From small tea bowls to heavy mahogany tables—one well-placed kick turns mundane furniture into lethal projectiles.

games.title: The Flowership
games.description: The Flowership calls to you. To have a heart pure is what we all desire. Though a long journey, the flowers of pure soil believe in you.

games.title: 迷宫：囚笼 Maze : Captivity
games.description: A relaxing puzzle game. Combine spells and items to better traverse the maze. Through the maze trial, we shall select mages who possess both wisdom and talent. Come, contribute your strength to the nation! Seek the final exit and solve the mystery!

games.title: Lemy
games.description: Condemned to Hell for a forgotten sin, Lemy receives an offer: 'Hunt down the monsters that have occupied the afterlife, and I will reduce the weight of your sins.' Experience a unique, mouse-driven action-adventure. Help Lemy atone and reclaim her past.

games.title: DEVIL GATE
games.description: DEVIL GATE® це похмура Action RPG у жанрі Hack & Slash. Розтрощуйте орди чудовиськ, полюйте на рідкісну здобич і підкорюйте Asartarion. Об’єднуйте два класи, поєднуйте їхні здібності та створюйте унікальні білди. Киньте виклик темряві наодинці або з друзями в кооперативі до 4 гравців!

games.title: Dinobreak: The Hatching
games.description: Race against time and teeth to save the city of Cypress Ridge from a dinosaur invasion in this 4-player online co-op remake of the 2023 game.

games.title: Unbowed
games.description: Choose your fate in this single-player pirate Soulslike where you explore cursed lands, battle eldritch horrors, and pillage any treasure you find. Death is only a temporary setback on the path to mastering brutal combat.

games.title: オブジェクト・ハッピーエンディング
games.description: “You” are the only human to have arrived in a world inhabited by non-human beings with the characteristics of objects, commonly known as “Objects.” A visual novel game in which you grant the Objects—who can only end their lives through human hands—the endings they desire.

games.title: Unstable Table
games.description: Survive the lunch rush in Unstable Table, a physics-based chaos-sim. Battle Boss Karens with rule-breaking mechanics, reassemble modular burgers after purse hits, and manage a shared Rage Meter in co-op. Use XP to balance your character and cash to buy 'Karen Counters.' Serve or be served...

games.title: Bravely Doomed
games.description: A deck-builder roguelike where you draft cards, explore fog-of-war dungeons, and fight in turn-based combat. Meet NPCs with dynamic dialogue, uncover deep lore, and conquer a mysterious dungeon floor by floor.

games.title: Destructor2D
games.description: 2D racing sim with soft-body physics, car deformations, highway driving, demolition derby, professional racing, crash racing, drifting, truck racing, open wheel racing, advanced AI with up to 50 cars on track, and more.

games.title: Project: Shinova
games.description: The young boy, Quill, finds himself accidentally travelling through different worlds to prevent a total restart of the universe while fighting corrupted fallen angels. And while doing so, he discovers a dark and hidden history of humanity.

games.title: The Blackout Project
games.description: Manage your contry energy requirements, avoid blackouts, sustain industrial developpement, avoid civilization collapsing.

games.title: Bound City
games.description: An action-packed and bittersweet adventure in a city of endless night. Explore the dying city and try to find your way to the tower that seems to be at the heart of it all. Nothing is quite as it appears to be, and only by facing death can you hope to understand the mysteries of Bound City.

games.title: RabbitConquest
games.description: In a world ruled by rabbits instead of humans, this is an adventure story about labyrinth appraisers who get caught up in a conspiracy surrounding a 'magic fruit.' It's a traditional 3D command RPG that anyone can play through to the ending in about 4 hours.

games.title: Patchwork Home
games.description: Patchwork Home is a dating action game where you help a colorful cast of characters build a home in a world that has broken more times than they can count. But, for some reason, these goofballs think this time it'll be different. Make sure that it is. Currently in Alpha.

games.title: Malk
games.description: You are Malk. You survived where you were meant to die. And now you are paying for it. Fanatics are hunting you. Aristocrats are playing with your life. And power is your only chance not to become dirt beneath someone else’s boots. Allies betray you. Patrons use you. No one gets a second chance.

games.title: Farmastrophy With Friends
games.description: 🌱 Welcome to Farmastrophy — where farming meets total chaos! You're a farmer on a mission. Grow crops, cook meals, and deliver everything to the tractor - before time runs out. games.title: Westins World
games.description: Westins World is a turn-based RPG where sci-fi meets fantasy. After a supernova scatters civilizations across the galaxy, lead Westin and his party through a story-driven adventure: explore, swap heroes on the fly, gear up your party and face the bosses standing in your way.

games.title: Asylum 1966
games.description: A forgotten asylum. A missing daughter. A man with nothing left to lose. In Asylum 1966, descend into a decaying institution where reality bends and shadows whisper secrets. What you uncover will test your sanity and your choices will shape your fate.

games.title: Enemies Within
games.description: Battle corrupted enemies, liberate afflicted allies, and explore a modernly medieval world on the verge of self-destruction in this action-packed 2D side scrolling adventure.

games.title: Gemini X
games.description: The Heretechs have seized Gemini Colony! Explore, upgrade, and blast your way to victory in Gemini X: a Metroidvania built for fans of classic 32-bit run-and-gun platformers.

games.title: Impound Rumble
games.description: Impound Rumble is an upcoming indie platform fighter bursting with personality! Rumble online with rollback or offline in a co-op story mode or duke it out PvP-style. Pop-off and go crazy with Turbo Mode and send friends and foes flying through stages that adapt to the chaos you create!

games.title: 汉阳造
games.description: Made in Hanyang is a top-down real-time tactics game. Lead outgunned Chinese resistance fighters through impossible missions—and find the courage to keep shooting when surrender is not an option. Currently available in Simplified Chinese only. English localization is planned for a future update.

games.title: 双獭奇兵
games.description: Two-player co-op underwater adventure with two otters. Unique skills: explore, fight, puzzle, gather. Coordinate attacks, overcome obstacles, activate mechanisms, upgrade gear. Tethered by kelp, sync movement, rescue partner. Local or LAN. Hilarious teamwork.

games.title: Many Ducks
games.description: Many Ducks is a cozy creature-collecting life sim where you win wild ducks over with music. Explore the woods, grow your flock, make your ranch your own, and raise a flock worthy of leading the Duck Parade.

games.title: Raven Gold
games.description: Raven Gold is a classic-style RPG featuring a handcrafted world. Explore unique dungeons, defeat powerful enemies, and conquer challenging puzzles to find rewarding treasure! Manage your resources carefully, especially your money, to achieve long term success as a fledgling adventurers guild.

games.title: Прекрасний у смерті
games.description: Гра, представлена від першої особи, з особливимъ наголосомъ на діалоги та історичну достовірність, дія котрої розгортається у літа з 1848-хъ по 1901-і роки. Вамъ належить увійти у роль фотографа з суворими вусами, що присвятивъ себе ремеслу посмертної фотографії.

games.title: 哈基米的海上漂流
games.description: A survival shooter game set at sea, where players must gather supplies, locate hidden shelters, and build rafts to survive. On the ocean surface, you'll need to fish with a rod, diligently collect drifting supplies with hooks, construct rafts, and grow food to stay alive.

games.description: GrimmVale is a story-rich RPG set in a dark world of twisted fairy tales. games.description: Очольте «Світанок» в Ефесі доби Нерона. Готуйте склади й тактики для 5 на 5 → 3 на 3 → 2 на 2 та втручайтеся в бій. Витрачайте призові на викуп, погоджуйте контракти з вільними бійцями, тренуйте й споряджайте загін, ходіть у рейди, повертайтеся сильнішими на арену й піднімайтеся з 5-го дивізіону.

games.title: ZEROSEGI
games.description: A TRPG × Visual Novel led by the roll of the dice. You arrive at Seiria Magic Academy just one week before the centennial 'Violet Eclipse.' Immerse yourself in campus life, romance seven heroines, and uncover the world's hidden secrets. Your choices alone will reshape the fate of this world.

games.title: Same End
games.description: Discover Dienna, a young reaper tired of having to deal with troubled souls, who prefers to challenge them with trials where their lives are at stake. A platformer and Die and Retry runner game featuring multiple branching paths and alternative endings, hand-drawn in the style of a lightly animated.

games.title: Destination Empire
games.description: Destination Empire is a 3D platformer hack-and-slash with fast tactical RPG elements. Fight large enemy groups, stop time with Kairos, quickly reskill to adapt your tactics, and switch to first person to uncover alternative solutions.

games.title: Fish Market
games.description: A cosy fish market simulator where you cut fresh fish, turn them into products like sushi, and collect rare species. Build a peaceful market, master satisfying preparation mechanics, and grow your seafood business at your own pace.

games.title: 天朝远征军
games.description: 'Dynasty Rush' is an official Chinese-themed TD game. Command legendary heroes and unique towers across iconic Chinese landscapes. Experience deep strategy infused with rich culture as you defend the realm. The vast empire awaits your command!

games.title: In The Valley of Gods
games.description: From the creators of Firewatch, In the Valley of Gods is a single-player first-person adventure. Explore a remote and ancient valley in the Egyptian desert, uncovering treasure and treachery in pursuit of a discovery that could bring you fame and fortune—or leave you for dead, buried beneath the sands.

games.title: Timberquest
games.description: Embark on an adventure in our RPG game! Explore a new, wild continent and fight to survive against environmental factors and monsters. With a heavy focus on cooperative play. Customize your character's stat-driven abilities to suit your preferred playstyle.

games.title: Keystone Titans VR
games.description: Keystone Titans VR is a VR Autobattler where units will need to be strategically selected and arranged to dominate your opponents. Outsmart the enemy with clever drafting, positioning, and economy management to form the strongest team.

games.title: Colors Assemble
games.description: Help Brad reunite with his family and complete all hand-crafted 2D platform challenges in a colorful twisted world. Handcra

games.description: Awaken without memory in a seemingly peaceful world. In this 2.5D puzzle-platformer, use the gift of the Streak (short-range teleportation), whose potential unfolds over time. Encounter fascinating creatures and uncover the truth that waits in hiding.

games.title: Pozionista
games.description: Experiment with ingredients and discover new ways to make potions, since each potion is the result of specific combinations of elements, what you will need is to mix herbs in the correct way and not necessarily a recipe. Rediscover potions forgotten in time through an old map showing where the knowledge of each forgotten potion is kept. There is a problem, the valley has changed and the map is no longer very reliable, so use the libraries in each town to find information about this forgotten civilization and tales

games.description: Umbra's Cauldron is a 2D card-stacking game in which every element of the game is a card. You have turned into a book and are now looking for a way to get back to your original form. Combine cards, discover recipes and fill your blank pages with knowledge.

games.title: Formula Team
games.description: Formula team management. The Formula Team will allow you to play the role of a team director, the success of the entire team will depend on you. If you are a huge Formula fan and have always been excited about the racing atmosphere? This game is made just for you.

games.title: Onlympic Up!
games.description: A lightning strike, a torch in your hands, and a voice echoes: “Your fates are now bound.” Tied together by a fragile rope — if it snaps, the fall is inevitable. Jump, climb, solve, slide… but never lose your rhythm. Only the patient will glimpse the summit.

games.description: Villages™ is a game that combines interesting mechanics from many other sandbox games. It aims to let People face a variety of gameplay and scenario by conducting a few basic rules. games.title: ANAMNESIS: memoria war
games.description: Will you die and be free of pain? Or live and break the shackles of fate? Can two souls, bound by fate itself, sever the never-ending cycle of death? 'ANAMESIS: memoria war' is a gorgeous 2D jRPG rich in story, heavy on action and steeped in deep characterization.

games.title: Vampire vs Devil
games.description: Використовуй тіла своїх ворогів як зброю. Шукай ключі, щоб відчиняти двері. Використовуй хитрощі, щоб бути швидшим. Один неправильний рух — і ти мертвий, але у тебе стільки життів, скільки потрібно, щоб пройти 666 рівнів до пекла. Останній бос, сам Диявол, чекає на тебе. Спробуй битися з ним, якщо наважишся... Vampire vs Devil — це моторошний 2D платформер з ретро-графікою в стилі піксель-арт, подібний до старих ігрових консолей. Твоя мета — перемогти ворогів і завершити кожен із 666 рівнів. Ти маєш битися і перема

games.title: Dawn of Demons
games.description: Become a medieval monk and confront the demon that has haunted the Boar Lake village. Confront 21 demons, originating from 7 houses of sins. Find, recognize, decide and exorcise the demon! Overcome fear, battle the demons! Embark on the role of a medieval monk and collaborate with your brethren. FIND Find the place where a cursed object lies, locate the items you need that will assist you in identifying who you are dealing with! RECOGNIZE Perform tests that will help you determine the demon's identity. Always remem

games.description: Bring Me Hope - це гірко-солодка пригодницька RPG про кохання, втрату та сім’ю. Досліджуйте світ відлунь і спогадів, де кожен бій випробовує вашу рішучість, а кожна таємниця шепоче про щось більше.

games.title: Jasper's Dream
games.description: Jasper's Dream is a first person puzzle game set in a techno mystic Egyptian world. Help Jasper, a robot programmed to create games, by solving his mind-bending puzzles. You will also explore an abandonned futuristic pyramid and unravel its many mysteries.

games.title: Goojeegoop
games.description: Клікай-клікай-КЛІКАЙ і проривайся крізь нескінченні хвилі ворогів у захопливому новому point-and-click roguelike — і ставай неймовірно сильним! Клікай по ворогах, щоб відкривати нові слоти, підвищувати рівень і створювати божевільні та видовищні білди!

games.title: 封禅记(The Legend of Zen Town)
games.description: The Legend of Zen Town is a classic turn-based RPG driven by a rich narrative. Explore a world where Chinese folklore blends with vibrant street culture, hidden beneath a modern city. Uncover supernatural mysteries and ancient secrets through striking art and storytelling.

games.title: Tidespawn
games.description: Занурся у магічний світ цієї піксельної пригодницької RPG. Досліджуй затоплені руїни, бийся з морськими чудовиськами, віднови забуті спогади та стань господарем своєї долі у небезпечних глибинах.

games.title: LoopCraft
games.description: Loop Craft is a game about economics. There is an item trading system within the game. This game has a variety of item mix systems. And have a reservation system to set up a factory to produce products for sale in the game.

games.title: Waste Of Life
games.description: You crashed on Garb'aaj, a planet made of trash, and you owe money for the ship. Scavenge, swap your body parts one finger at a time, fight drones built from garbage, and recycle the whole planet into a real one. Solo or co-op.

games.title: PlayLife: Life Deck Simulator
games.description: A card-based life simulation where every choice is a card. Build your deck, shape your destiny, and explore multiple paths with 21 skills and 22 careers. Marry, stay single, get rich, or start over—every run tells a new life story.

games.title: Plague hunter
games.description: Plague hunter is an indie platformer game in the dark fantasy vein. In the game you’ll be using sword and gun to cut your way through hordes of zombies and other terrible monsters, avoiding deadly traps.

games.title: Sneak Pit
games.description: Sneak Pit is the working title for an EXTREMELY alpha stealth / immersive sim experience. Use a variety of weapons and items to outsmart the enemy and access restricted areas crucial to your mission. More details and features to come.

games.title: The Guardians Realm
games.description: The Guardians Realm is an open-world Fantasy RPG in a medieval setting. It's inspired by other great RPGs like Runescape and Classic WoW, and focuses on combat, crafting, gathering, and exploring. OPEN WORLD In The Guardians Realm, your survival hinges on your skills in combat, crafting, gathering, and exploration. Engage in dynamic, skill-based combat with a free-moving camera that gives you full battlefield control and the ability to engage with multiple enemies. Craft powerful weapons and armor, gather resources

games.title: 喵雪小萌萌
games.description: Nyaukimoe is an anime and pixel art style catgirl Metroidvania platformer. Play as Nyaukimoe, fighting and exploring dark areas with a Cat Scratcher and glowsticks, searching for her lost sister.

games.title: Uncharted Sectors
games.description: Глобальна стратегія з глибокою економічною симуляцією під керівництвом розумного ШІ-оповідача. Забезпечте виживання своїх володінь на краю галактики: колонізуйте світи, керуйте населенням, вершіть політику, створюйте унікальні товари та підкорюйте динамічні ринки.
